title: Bacterial carnitine metabolism.
scope: Abstract read. Historical comparative pathway review; first-step chemistry is explicit, but this predates modern identification of downstream enzymes.

title: Carnitine metabolism and its regulation in microorganisms and mammals.
scope: Abstract read. Comparative prokaryotic and mammalian review; use bacterial nutrient/electron-acceptor distinction, not mammalian mitochondrial biology as bacterial pathway evidence.

title: Carnitine in bacterial physiology and metabolism.
scope: Abstract read. PMC HTML returned a challenge and efetch XML explicitly withholds the full text. No full-text sections or substrate-level experiments are claimed from this review.

title: Homeostasis and catabolism of choline and glycine betaine: lessons from Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
scope: Abstract read. This minireview concerns choline/GB homeostasis, not experimental assignment of the three carnitine enzymes.

title: The ATP-binding cassette transporter Cbc (choline/betaine/carnitine) recruits multiple substrate-binding proteins with strong specificity for distinct quaternary ammonium compounds.
scope: Cached abstract and collaborator full-source consultation support shared-core import. Assay strain and construct bridges are recorded in member reviews; KT2440 native transport measurements are not inferred.

title: Purification and properties of carnitine dehydrogenase from Pseudomonas putida.
scope: Abstract explicitly names P. putida IFP206. This is direct reaction evidence, not an assay of KT2440 Q88R32 or all Pseudomonas enzymes.

title: Identification of genes required for Pseudomonas aeruginosa carnitine catabolism.
scope: Cached abstract read; companion gene consultation recovered full text and distinguishes PAO1 insertion mutants from PA14 deletion/lysate assays. Genetic requirement is not isolated-enzyme substrate specificity.

title: Revealing the hidden functional diversity of an enzyme family.
scope: Abstract and supplementary-data consultations support BKACE functional diversity. Accession-to-assay mapping must precede attributing a screened reaction to a member; generic family results and G5 kinetics are not target assays.

title: Characterization of l-Carnitine Metabolism in Sinorhizobium meliloti.
scope: Abstract plus independently documented full-source and sequence consultation. Proteins cloned from 3D0a2 match Rm2011 and frozen 1021 targets exactly; Rm1021 GBB-growth failure remains distinct from purified protein chemistry.

title: Proteomic and metabolomic analysis reveals new insights into quaternary amine metabolism in Citrobacter amalonaticus CJ25.
scope: Full cached article read. CJ25 metabolomics/proteomics suggests candidate Fad homologs and a trimethylaminoacetone route; it does not reconstitute the CdhC/betainyl-CoA route or validate its enzyme identities.

title: Production of L-carnitine by secondary metabolism of bacteria.
scope: Full text sections1 (comparative bacterial pathways) and2.2 (biotechnological methods) read. This is a narrative review despite the machine cache classification PRIMARY_RESEARCH; cache remains unchanged. It predates downstream CdhC/CdhB assignments and does not prove modern target accessions or exact thioesterase chemistry.
